title: Vintage Soviet Melchior Fork, USSR Nickel Silver Flatware
categoryName: Collectibles:Kitchen & Home:Flatware, Knives & Cutlery:Single Flatware Pieces
descriptionText:
Up for sale is a vintage Soviet-era Melchior (МНЦ) fork, featuring an elegant floral pattern on the handle. This fork was produced in the USSR and is made from a durable copper-nickel-zinc alloy, resembling silver. The back is stamped "ЛУЧШИХ МНЦ", meaning "Best Melchior," indicating high-quality craftsmanship.

🔹 Material: Melchior (nickel silver alloy)
🔹 Length: Approx. [insert measurement] inches
🔹 Era: Likely 1970s Soviet Union production
🔹 Manufacturer: Possibly Kolchugino Plant or a similar USSR flatware producer
🔹 Condition: Some patina and wear consistent with age, but overall in great shape for a vintage piece.

This is a collectible Soviet-era flatware piece, perfect for vintage kitchenware enthusiasts, history collectors, or anyone looking to add a unique touch to their dining set.
